evidence.text: Attempted to open the official U+723A 爺 and U+8036 耶 Unihan records; both were inaccessible through the web tool. The local file sources/unihan/Unihan_Readings.txt contains kMandarin rows 爺 yé and 耶 yé, as well as 爷 yé and 父 fù. These current readings are metadata and do not establish an ancient sound relationship.

evidence.text: The exact file page identifies 父-seal.svg as a modern vector rendering of 父 in the Shuowen seal-script style and names Sinica Database and Chinese Etymology among its sources, with an s02164 reference to hanziyuan.net. The page grants public-domain use of the representation. The original image link is https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/43/%E7%88%B6-seal.svg. This is a modern redraw, not an artifact photograph; it illustrates 父’s seal-script form only and is not evidence of 爺’s historical graphic sequence.
evidence.title: File:父-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

search_audit.query: Unicode Unihan U+723A 爺 kMandarin record U+8036 耶; Wikimedia Commons File 父-seal.svg description page seal script 父
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the exact Commons file description and its original-image link; the direct SVG fetch was rejected by the web tool because of its content type. The two official Unihan record pages could not be opened. Cross-checked the supplied local kMandarin rows in sources/unihan/Unihan_Readings.txt; they give 爺 yé and 耶 yé (plus 爷 yé and 父 fù).

gaps: The official individual Unihan records for 爺 and 耶 were inaccessible in this run. Their exact current readings are supported here by the inspected local Unihan table rows only; the official Unicode click-through pages could not be verified.
No Baxter–Sagart comparison can be given for 耶 and 爺: the supplied local Baxter–Sagart rows cover 父 only. No claim about the historical phonetic relation follows from the modern yé/yé match.

The 父-seal.svg candidate depicts a component, not the complete graph 爺, and does not establish 爺’s formation or graphic history. The browser rejected the direct SVG fetch, so its pixels were not independently inspected.

limitations.text: This modern redraw shows only 父. It cannot document the historical shape, formation date, or development of 爺. The direct SVG was not pixel-inspected because the web tool rejected its content type.
